integrity: An algebraic all-parameter proof is supplied, with a separately executable exact-rational finite checker; tests are not infinite proof. Full independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only canonical Euclidean-orthogonal cut/cycle projectors in unweighted real edge coordinate spaces; no minimum-norm projection or nonorthogonal optimality claim. Prior complete-multipartite resistance formulas are acknowledged and imply transfer-current entries through polarization. Residual risk of equivalent endpoint-norm expression in electrical-network literature. The original 2012 resistance article PDF was not retrievable, while the same resistance formula was inspected in a 2016 full text.
title: Exact endpoint Hodge norms and an edge-orbit reversal for complete multipartite graphs
